draft.emotion: wary and cautious, keeping a safe distance from a potential risk
notes: Literally 'a person (I) don't know', formed from 知る (shiru, 'to know') in the negative plain form 知らない + 人 (hito, 'person').
他人 (tanin) also translates as 'stranger' or 'other people', but emphasizes being unrelated or an outsider rather than simply someone you have never met.
